caption:
The video captures a wide pale salt-desert plain under an overcast sky, with low brown mountains along the horizon. A three-wheeled motorcycle with sidecar carries two people across the open ground. The driver, in a tan jacket, holds a small device up to their face as they move.

A passenger in dark clothing sits in the sidecar, and the pair travel away and slightly rightward across the frame. To their left, several small ground objects continue emitting orange flame and white smoke. The smoke plume stretches sideways, and the flames flicker in size. A thin tripod appears at the frame's right edge and remains visible as the shot tightens.

The vehicle grows larger as the framing tightens, while its distance from the burning objects widens. The driver keeps the device raised to the head, and the passenger remains seated in the sidecar without changing their posture.

The scattered fires and smoke remain active throughout, showing an ongoing process rather than a new ignition within the visible portion of this excerpt.
